comment_regular: Plays a selected BSAnimGroupSequence. Resolves default slot from fixed group metadata, maps physical slot 5->0 and 6->3 while retaining the requested alias for clear semantics, handles menu/full reset conditions, records active key +0x3C and sequence +0xA0, chooses morph only for matching nonzero morph keys and equal controller counts, otherwise cross-fades or blends from a temporary pose, applies the maximum old/new Blend byte as transition time, and initializes slot action state.
